sports_and_recreation.name: Sportplex Arena
sports_and_recreation.description: A massive indoor multi-sport arena hosting basketball, tennis, football (soccer), and volleyball tournaments by day, which transforms into an active social, gaming, and dance venue by night.

sports_and_recreation.name: Himalayan Suspension Bridge
sports_and_recreation.description: An outdoor suspension ropes adventure course suspended 80 meters (262 ft) above sea level spanning across the aft deck near the aquapark.

sports_and_recreation.name: Power Walking & Jogging Track
sports_and_recreation.description: An outdoor, multi-lane walking and jogging loop wrapping around the upper deck perimeter with unobstructed sea views.

sports_and_recreation.name: Virtual Games Arcade & Simulators
sports_and_recreation.description: High-tech gaming complex featuring motion simulators, bowling, and interactive entertainment.

sub_attractions.name: Formula 1 Simulators
sub_attractions.description: Two full-scale, authentic Formula 1 virtual racing cars with realistic force-feedback hydraulic movement.

sub_attractions.name: XD Dark Ride Cinema
sub_attractions.description: An interactive 3D shooter/ride game theater featuring synchronized motion seats and laser blasting challenges.

sports_and_recreation.name: MSC Gym by Technogym
sports_and_recreation.description: State-of-the-art fitness center outfitted with Technogym cardio machines, weight lifting benches, stretching areas, and certified fitness instructors offering spin and yoga classes.
